QF.id: SIA Social Stock Exchange Introduction and Instruments_45

question.text: Chapter 2 references the Indian philanthropy market (as an opportunity that DIBs can help build trust in). The size of this market is estimated at approximately:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 2.3.1.2 ('How DIBs can benefit from the SSE in India'), the text states that improved reporting and transparency in DIB structures 'can help build a lot more trust for the philanthropy market which is estimated at over INR 35,000 crore.' This is the pre-SSE Indian philanthropy market estimate. The Trap: Option B (3,500 crore) is 10x too low. Option C (3.5 lakh crore) is 10x too high. Option D (350 crore) is 100x too low. Cross-Exam Context: V-A (MF Distributor) and X-A/X-B (IA) reference similar market-size estimates for HNI philanthropy. XII (SMF) treats capital-market sizing. Assessor's Pro-Tip: Use the INR 35,000 crore figure to contextualise the SSE's early-stage capital flow — the first wave of ZCZP issuances (Jan 2023 onwards) totalling a few dozen crore is a tiny fraction of the philanthropy pool, showing why the SIA's assurance credibility is the key multiplier to unlock scale.
